summary: First-finish smoke test of mAIPAL. Backend: root, auth (401/200), tasks/todos/conversations CRUD list, NDJSON streaming with all 3 actions (info_upload, info_request, task_todo), task creation from LLM JSON block, and multi-user isolation all pass. Frontend: landing, chat, tasks, todos pages render correctly with seeded data and Apple-style design.
passed: GET /api/auth/me: 401 without token, 200 with Bearer test_session_demo_12345 returning Marco Rossi profile (onboarded=true)
GET /api/tasks returns 2 seeded tasks for demo user
GET /api/conversations returns list scoped to user
POST /api/chat/stream action=info_upload streams delta tokens then {type:done, conv_id}, persists conversation with pipeline {claude:ok, n8n:skip, mongodb:ok}
POST /api/chat/stream action=info_request retrieves KB context (recalled '15 marzo' compleanno) and streams contextual answer
POST /api/chat/stream action=task_todo parses ```json``` block and creates new task in Mongo (verified 3rd task 'Chiamare il dentista' appears in GET /api/tasks)
POST /api/tasks creates a task ('Test CRUD') owned by demo user
Multi-user isolation: user A PATCH on user B task returned null response with DB state unchanged (task_b1 still owned by user B, title unchanged)
FRONTEND Landing: 'Accedi con Google' button visible, gradient 'mAIPAL' word rendered
FRONTEND Chat page: headline 'Cosa vuoi fare, Marco?', 3 action selector cards, CLAUDE SONNET 5 badge, history filters (Tutti/Upload/Query/ToDo), date input all rendered
FRONTEND Action toggle: clicking 'Richiesta informazioni' switches it to ATTIVO (confirmed in screenshot)
FRONTEND Task Board: 3 columns Alta/Media/Bassa with tasks in correct columns, tag chips, due-date pill
FRONTEND ToDo Board: 3 status columns, progress bar visible (40%) for in_corso todo

failed.issue: User pydantic model has created_at: Optional[str]; if any user document has created_at stored as BSON Date (datetime) instead of ISO string, get_current_user throws ValidationError and returns 500. Real signup path uses .isoformat() strings so production is safe, but seed scripts or admin inserts could break it.
failed.evidence: Backend log: 'Input should be a valid string [type=string_type, input_value=datetime.datetime(...)]' when I test-seeded a user with new Date().

failed.issue: PATCH /api/tasks/{id} on a task not owned by caller returns HTTP 200 with null body instead of 404. Data is safe (no modification occurs), but response is misleading.
failed.evidence: curl PATCH user_A auth against task_b1 -> 200 null; DB unchanged.

action_items: (Optional) Return 404 from PATCH/DELETE /api/tasks/{id} and /api/todos/{id} when task/todo is not found or not owned, instead of 200 null.
(Optional) Make User.created_at accept both str and datetime, or normalize on load, to harden against BSON date inserts.

success_rate.backend: 100% (all critical endpoints pass; only two low-severity response-code polish items)
